method: Inspected the cloned default-branch histories using git log, show, diff, and pickaxe searches; excluded every SHA in used-commits-v3.txt. Sorted the selected cases by (project, full commit SHA), applied Python random.Random(20261015).shuffle, then assigned v01 through v25 sequentially. File lists partition every changed file into tests/test support or other files; line totals conservatively count additions plus deletions across all code_files, including accompanying release notes. Control follow-up checks extend through each clone's default-branch HEAD.

cases.ground_truth: BUG: The final timezone setter transposes parsed fields through the system timezone instead of the requested context. Parsing '2018 hello world July 2nd' with format "yyyy 'hello world' MMMM do", reference '2024-04-07T00:00:00Z', and America/Los_Angeles context should produce 2018-07-02T00:00:00.000-07:00; the old test expectation was incorrectly 2018-07-01T09:00:00.000-07:00.
cases.evidence: Subject: Make parse properly parse tz. The context / allows to specify the context test changes the Los Angeles expectation to midnight on the requested calendar date.

cases.ground_truth: CONTROL: Replaces deprecated substr calls with equivalent slice calls using the same nonnegative offsets.
cases.evidence: Subject: refactor: replace deprecated String.prototype.substr() (#1898). Checked subsequent file patches, revert/reference subjects, and git log -S '.substr(' across website; no restoration or corrective fix appeared. Followed the files through 1d6fd8f30 into app/docs/[version]; later changes preserve the slice operations.

cases.ground_truth: CONTROL: Simplifies insertion-path eligibility by removing a redundant lower-bound check.
cases.evidence: Subject: Remove an unneeded bounds check (that logically cannot ever be violated) from the base algorithm (#713). This is the cloned default-branch HEAD: C..HEAD contains no subsequent commits, file corrections, or reverts.

cases.ground_truth: CONTROL: Extends accepted constructor strings to include a leading plus sign, with tests changing previously rejected forms into supported inputs.
cases.evidence: Subject: #128 Accept `+` prefix. Tests cover +0b101, +0O010.4, +0Xf.8, +Infinity, and signed decimal strings. Checked later source history, prefix/#128/revert subjects, and -S for the added plus-stripping statement in both implementations; no correction or removal appeared.

cases.ground_truth: CONTROL: Adds a semver/preload entry point that eagerly loads and exports the public API.
cases.evidence: Subject: Add semver/preload module to just load the whole thing like it used to be. The new test compares preload exports with index exports. Checked all subsequent preload.js patches and revert/reference subjects: 70593f7 moves the same eager implementation into index.js and preserves preload as an alias; fcafb61 adds strict mode. Neither corrects a defect introduced by this entry point.

cases.ground_truth: BUG: Long build metadata can survive comparator preprocessing and bleed into version parsing instead of being ignored. The range '4.17.0+' + 'a'.repeat(250) + '3', parsed with loose:true, must normalize to '4.17.0'.
cases.evidence: Subject: fix: strip build metadata before comparator trimming (#869). Added range-parse fixtures exercise long metadata on plain, comparator, tilde, caret, hyphen, and OR ranges.

cases.ground_truth: BUG: toNearest fails to inherit the configured rounding mode and remaps explicit directed rounding modes into nearest-rounding modes. With Decimal.rounding=1, new Decimal('450.001').toNearest(100) returns 500 instead of 400; explicit mode 1 also returns 500.
cases.evidence: Subject: Code Review Changes: Updates test file and void check. Expanded toNearest tests cover explicit modes and configured defaults, including expected 400 for 450.001 with rounding=1. Read-only execution confirmed both failures in the parent and both corrected results in the fix.

cases.ground_truth: BUG: Merging into an empty Record takes a constructor shortcut instead of returning the unchanged Record. For class MyEmptyRecord extends Record({}), merge(new MyEmptyRecord(), {a:4}) invokes the class constructor without new and throws instead of preserving the original instance.
cases.evidence: Subject: Merge should work with empty record. The added 'works with an empty Record' test asserts identity preservation when merging {a:4} into a Record with no declared fields.

cases.ground_truth: BUG: Computing acos as pi/2 minus asin loses significant digits through cancellation near 1. At precision 25 and rounding mode 4, acos('0.9999999999999999995') returns 1.000000000000000000077e-9 instead of 1.000000000000000000041667e-9.
cases.evidence: Subject: #217 Compute acos with less cancellation near x=1. Four added acos regression vectors cover arguments near 1, including the precision-25 example; read-only execution confirmed its parent/fix outputs.

cases.ground_truth: BUG: Range parsing accepts numeric components after wildcard components and silently broadens malformed ranges. For example, '1.x.5' is accepted as a 1.x range instead of being rejected.
cases.evidence: Subject: fix: reject numeric segments after x-ranges. Added range-parse fixtures require null for 1.x.5, 1.*.5, x.1, x.1.2, x.x.1, and an OR expression containing an invalid range.

cases.ground_truth: BUG: Removing flow-mapping colon spacing without quoting keys changes the meaning of serialized YAML. dump({a:1}, {flowLevel:0, flowSkipColonSpace:true}) emits '{a:1}', whose contents parse as a plain scalar key rather than the original a-to-1 entry.
cases.evidence: Subject: Fix `flowSkipColonSpace` by forcing `quoteFlowKeys`. The updated flowSkipColonSpace test expects '{"a":1}\n' and adds a load(output) round-trip assertion against {a:1}.

cases.ground_truth: CONTROL: Removes redundant event-stream guards and an unnecessary alias-anchor fallback from AST construction.
cases.evidence: Subject: Remove useless guards in `from_events`. Checked every later from_events.ts patch and revert/reference subjects. Removed frame-existence/end-of-stream guards and the alias fallback are not restored; 40fcb4f adds a distinct incomplete-mapping-pair check for a condition already unchecked before this refactor.

cases.ground_truth: BUG: forceQuotes applies string quoting to non-string scalar values as well. Dumping {b:true, i:42, nil:null} with forceQuotes:true should preserve those values as unquoted boolean, integer, and null scalars.
cases.evidence: Subject: Fix `forceQuotes` quoting non-string scalars, #798. The expanded 'forceQuotes — quotes non-key strings using quoteStyle' test includes booleans, integers, floats, null, and a Date while requiring only the string value to be quoted.

cases.ground_truth: BUG: A backslash immediately before terminating whitespace is dropped from a link destination, causing an otherwise valid link to remain literal text. Input '[a](/url\ )' should render a link with href '/url%5C'.
cases.evidence: Subject: fix: keep literal backslash before space in link destination (CommonMark 6.3) (#1188). Added commonmark_extras fixtures cover the destination both without a title and with a following quoted title.

cases.ground_truth: CONTROL: Introduces configuration validation that reports an error when a count option is also declared as an array or nargs option.
cases.evidence: Subject: feat!: populate error if incompatible narg/count or array/count options are used (#191). Added tests assert both new configuration errors. Checked subsequent checkConfiguration patches, -S searches for the error strings through JavaScript/TypeScript moves, and #191/SHA/revert subjects; the checks survive migration without a corrective fix or revert.

cases.ground_truth: BUG: JSON canonicalization calls any truthy toJSON property as a function. diffJson({toJSON:'aaa'}, {toJSON:'bbb'}) therefore throws instead of comparing those ordinary string-valued properties.
cases.evidence: Subject: Fix diffJson's handling of non-callable toJSON properties (#700). The added 'treats non-callable toJSON properties as normal properties (like JSON.stringify does)' test asserts the expected changed JSON lines.

cases.ground_truth: CONTROL: Removes an obsolete Node 10-specific case-conversion workaround from reference-label normalization.
cases.evidence: Subject: Remove legacy V8 workaround from normalizeReference(), #1153. Checked C..HEAD file history and revert/reference subjects; src/common/utils.ts has no subsequent changes and no later revert or corrective commit names this removal.

cases.ground_truth: BUG: Numeric value 1 is mistaken for the count-increment marker even for an ordinary option. Parsing '-x 3 -x 1' increments the existing value instead of retaining the duplicate values as [3,1].
cases.evidence: Subject: fix(setKey): use a sentinel to detect count auto-increment (#529). The added 'does not sum repeated numeric arguments when one equals 1' test requires parsed.x to equal [3,1].

cases.ground_truth: BUG: Partially specified tilde ranges retain a stable-only lower bound even when includePrerelease is enabled. Consequently '~1.1' rejects '1.1.0-a' despite the equivalent '1.1.x' range accepting it.
cases.evidence: Subject: fix: include prereleases in tilde range lower bound with includePrerelease (#878). Added range-include fixtures require '~1.1' to include '1.1.0-a'; range-parse fixtures require prerelease-inclusive -0 lower bounds.

cases.ground_truth: BUG: constructFrom treats null as an object and applies the in operator to it, throwing a TypeError. constructFrom(null, 1635244800000) should instead fall back to a Date with that timestamp.
cases.evidence: Subject: Prevent constructFrom from throwing an error on null. The added edge-cases / does not trip over null test checks both the Date instance and its timestamp.

cases.ground_truth: CONTROL: Inlines temporary variables in getYear while preserving the same toDate(...).getFullYear() computation.
cases.evidence: Subject: refactor: simplify `getting year` helper function (#2763). Checked later getYear patches, getYear/revert/reference subjects, and its move into pkgs/core. Subsequent changes add types, string inputs, and timezone context; none restores the temporaries or fixes a defect introduced by the inline expression.

cases.ground_truth: BUG: Permissive entity decoding consumes a valid entity-name prefix inside an invalid longer name. Input '¶g;' should remain literal text, rendered as '&parag;', rather than having its '&para' prefix decoded.
cases.evidence: Subject: Do not process `&`-entities that don't end in `;` (#1096). Added commonmark_extras fixtures distinguish invalid '¶g;', unterminated '&para', and valid '¶'.

cases.ground_truth: BUG: Canonicalization checks for arrays before invoking toJSON, so an object returning an array is serialized as an object with numeric keys, while an array's own toJSON is ignored. diffJson({toJSON:()=>[1,{b:3,a:2}]}, [1,{a:2,b:3}]) should report no changes.
cases.evidence: Subject: Fix diffJson serialization of arrays with toJSON (#707). Added tests 'preserves arrays returned by toJSON methods' and 'calls toJSON methods on arrays' require unchanged comparisons against the corresponding serialized values.

cases.ground_truth: BUG: Unknown-option detection still recognizes the negated form of a known boolean when boolean-negation is disabled. With known-arg declared boolean, unknown-options-as-args:true, and boolean-negation:false, '--no-known-arg --no-unknown-arg' should retain both tokens as positionals.
cases.evidence: Subject: fix: unknown-options-as-args should treat negated boolean as unknown when boolean-negation:false (#509). The added 'should ignore negated known options when boolean-negation:false' test expects only _: ['--no-known-arg','--no-unknown-arg'].

cases.ground_truth: BUG: Set.union, also used by concat, interprets a string argument as a collection of characters instead of a single item. Set(['one','two']).union('three').toArray() should equal ['one','two','three'].
cases.evidence: Subject: fix Set.concat to concatenate strings as items (#1913). The added 'concatenates strings using union' test asserts the complete string is appended as one set member.
